name: enum-group-deleting-moves-no-named-constant
description: A member whose deletion moves no constant that code names, because no named constant comes after it in its block or because it stands in a block of its own with no iota, is reported as an unused enum member, whatever values of its type a test or a call outside the program can make: deleting it leaves the program building and denoting the same value at every name it uses.
